items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: Well, I can give you two, that's all, is that alright? Sure. Buddy Petit and Kid Rene.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. Who was your favorite trumpet player of all the ones you heard when you were young? When I was young? Real old timers.
Well, I can give you two, that's all, is that alright? Sure. Buddy Petit and Kid Rene.
